product.title: Drape Composition 2
product.description: The Drape Composition 2 is a multi-pendant fixture with 3 pendants suspended from a single canopy. Each pendant is suspended on a fabric-wrapped electrical cord. The center pendant hangs straight down from the canopy and features a 7"/180mm diameter sphere of handblown glass. The outer pendants are swagged to ceiling hooks (included) – one features a smaller, 4.5"/110mm diameter sphere of handblown glass and the other a 6"/150mm diameter ellipsoid of handblown glass. The glass diffusers are available in both "dipped" glass, featuring the SkLO double-dipped flame-polished mouth and "textured" glass, featuring a soft, frosted finish and subtle sculpted vertical ridges. Cord lengths are field adjustable.
